title: China-to-Peru Industrial Motor Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Motor standard family and IE efficiency class alignment
rows.target_requirement: Peru uses Normas Técnicas Peruanas issued through INDECOPI, and industrial motor requirements commonly reference NTP adoptions of IEC 60034. For three-phase industrial AC motors, the practical target basis is NTP IEC 60034 with IE-class alignment for efficiency declarations. Export documentation should state the IEC 60034 motor class, rated voltage, rated frequency, duty, insulation class, enclosure, and efficiency class for the Peru configuration.
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A China GB or CCC file does not by itself establish Peru conformity. The Peru column should be built around the NTP IEC 60034 edition and the motor rating intended for 60 Hz operation, with local Spanish documentation where required.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when referenced by applicable Peru technical regulation, procurement specification, certification route, or product listing
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory or baseline depending on GB 18613 applicability and CCC scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat NTP IEC 60034 alignment as the Peru technical baseline and do not present CCC or a China-only GB report as Peru approval.

rows.requirement: Rated frequency class for Peru industrial motors
rows.target_requirement: Peru supply is 60 Hz. Industrial motors intended for Peru should be nameplated and tested for 60 Hz operation, including speed, torque, current, temperature rise, and efficiency at the declared 60 Hz rating. A China domestic 50 Hz-only motor should be treated as incompatible unless the manufacturer has validated a separate 60 Hz rating.
target_standards: OSINERGMIN grid and energy supervision context
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope. China domestic motor ratings are often configured for 50 Hz service.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: The critical mismatch is 60 Hz versus 50 Hz. Using a 50 Hz motor on a 60 Hz supply changes synchronous speed, torque behavior, current, heating, fan performance, and efficiency. Peru shipment should require a 60 Hz nameplate and test evidence, not only a China 50 Hz certificate.

mandatory_status.target: Critical practical requirement for Peru installation and conformity evidence
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic baseline often 50 Hz unless separately rated

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not ship a 50 Hz-only China motor as Peru-ready. Confirm and document a 60 Hz rating before quoting, labelling, or importing.

rows.requirement: Energy-efficiency label and IE class declaration
rows.target_requirement: Peru energy-efficiency expectations are administered through the national energy and standards framework involving MINEM and INDECOPI. For industrial motors, the practical file should state the IE class aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 and the 60 Hz rated test basis. Where an energy-efficiency label or declaration is required for the product category, the label content should match the Peru-rated configuration.
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A GB 18613 IE declaration may be useful evidence, but Peru-facing efficiency information must be tied to the NTP IEC or IEC method and the 60 Hz rating. A 50 Hz efficiency value can misstate performance under Peru service.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when the motor category is covered by Peru energy-efficiency labelling or declaration rules
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory under GB 18613 for covered China-market motors

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare Peru efficiency declarations around the 60 Hz Peru rating and IE class, not around a China-only 50 Hz GB 18613 value.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Energía y Minas del Perú

rows.target_requirement: For Peru service, efficiency evidence should be generated or converted with a defensible 60 Hz test basis. The file should identify test voltage, frequency, load points, ambient assumptions, measurement method, and whether the motor is dual-rated or Peru-specific.
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope. China evidence is commonly produced for 50 Hz ratings unless the model is also tested at 60 Hz.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A 50 Hz efficiency test report is not a clean substitute for 60 Hz Peru evidence. The exporter should either test the same model at 60 Hz or provide a lab-supported engineering basis for the 60 Hz declared value.

mandatory_status.target: Critical for truthful Peru-rated energy and nameplate declarations
mandatory_status.cn: China evidence may be mandatory domestically but often frequency-specific

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Flag every 50 Hz-only efficiency report as insufficient for Peru until a 60 Hz rating is validated.

rows.target_requirement: Peru-market nameplates should show information consistent with NTP IEC 60034 practice and any required energy-efficiency declaration, including rated voltage, 60 Hz frequency, power, current, speed, duty, insulation, protection degree, and IE class where declared.
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A nameplate that only lists 380 V 50 Hz, China efficiency grade, or CCC data creates a Peru mismatch. Peru-facing marking should clearly show 380 V line-to-line where applicable and 60 Hz operation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when required by applicable technical regulation, certification route, or import documentation
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China-market covered products under applicable GB and CCC marking rules

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Rework the nameplate for the Peru-rated 60 Hz configuration before market access review.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Energía y Minas del Perú

rows.requirement: EMC evidence for motor and drive combinations
rows.target_requirement: Standalone induction motors may have limited EMC emissions, but Peru projects often evaluate the installed motor, variable-speed drive, control panel, and cabling as a system. Where EMC evidence is requested, the file should identify the tested configuration and IEC-based emissions or immunity standard used.
target_standards: IEC 61800-3 for adjustable speed electrical power drive systems where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope. EMC evidence may come from China GB or CCC files for covered electrical equipment, but scope can differ from the Peru installation.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A China EMC or CCC report for only the motor or only the drive may not cover the Peru system as imported or installed. The importer should map tested models, drive settings, filters, cable lengths, and earthing assumptions.

mandatory_status.target: Project-dependent or mandatory when required by applicable Peru technical regulation, buyer specification, or listed equipment route
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory only where China EMC or CCC scope covers the equipment

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Use China EMC evidence only after confirming the tested configuration matches the Peru motor-drive system.

rows.requirement: Grid compatibility and power quality interface
rows.target_requirement: OSINERGMIN supervises the energy and grid context in Peru. Industrial motor packages should be checked against local 60 Hz supply, site voltage, starting current, harmonics from drives, protection coordination, and power quality expectations for the installation.
target_standards: OSINERGMIN energy and grid supervision framework
Peru 220/127 V single-phase and 380/220 V industrial three-phase, 60 Hz supply practice
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope. China designs may assume 50 Hz grid operation.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: Voltage may look superficially close to China industrial ratings, but frequency is not. Peru three-phase 380/220 V at 60 Hz requires motor and drive settings validated for that grid, not only a 380 V 50 Hz China setup.

mandatory_status.target: Critical installation requirement and may be mandatory under project, utility, or safety review
mandatory_status.cn: China grid assumptions do not transfer automatically

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Validate the complete motor package for Peru 60 Hz grid conditions before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: INDECOPI conformity route for listed products
rows.target_requirement: For listed regulated products, Peru import may require INDECOPI-recognized product certification, a conformity declaration, or documentation showing compliance with the applicable NTP or technical regulation. The importer should confirm whether the exact motor or motor package is listed before shipment.
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: CCC is not recognized as Peru approval. It can support a technical file but does not replace a Peru conformity declaration, INDECOPI-recognized certification, or listed-product import evidence.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for listed products and otherwise required when a technical regulation applies
mandatory_status.cn: CCC mandatory only for China scope and not recognized as Peru approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Check the Peru listing and conformity route before shipment; do not rely on CCC as a substitute.

rows.target_requirement: SUNAT administers Peru customs. The importer should prepare invoice, packing list, HS classification, origin data, technical datasheet, Spanish product description where needed, and any conformity or energy-efficiency documents required for release.
target_standards: Applicable conformity or energy-efficiency documents for listed goods
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: China export paperwork alone does not close Peru customs risk. The customs file should connect the HS code and model to the Peru technical file, 60 Hz rating, and any required INDECOPI or energy-efficiency evidence.

mandatory_status.cn: Export documentation required but not sufficient for Peru release

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Tie customs documents to the Peru technical and 60 Hz conformity file before dispatch.

rows.target_requirement: PRODUCE is relevant to Peru industrial policy and industrial regulatory context. For motor packages used in factories, processing plants, or industrial machinery, importers should check whether sector-specific industrial, safety, or machinery rules add requirements beyond general motor standards.
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A motor sold as part of a machine may trigger broader industrial documentation than a bare motor shipment. The Peru review should identify whether the import is a component, a motor-drive package, or complete machinery.

mandatory_status.target: Depends on product use, sector, and machinery package
mandatory_status.cn: China motor baseline does not resolve Peru sector rules

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Classify the shipment as bare motor, motor package, or machinery before deciding the Peru compliance route.

rows.target_requirement: Peru industrial motors should be documented for the local low-voltage installation, including insulation class, temperature rise, earthing, terminal box, enclosure protection, overload protection interface, and safe operation at 60 Hz. For listed products, Peru conformity evidence may be required before import or sale.
target_standards: Applicable Peru low-voltage and electrical installation requirements
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: China safety evidence may not prove safe operation under Peru 60 Hz conditions. Temperature rise, cooling fan speed, bearing speed, and overload settings should be reviewed for the Peru rating.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where applicable Peru electrical safety or listed-product conformity rules apply
mandatory_status.cn: CCC mandatory only for China scope and not recognized as Peru approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Review safety at the Peru 60 Hz operating point before relying on China low-voltage or CCC documentation.

rows.requirement: Protection, environment, and industrial installation safety
rows.target_requirement: Peru industrial sites may require motor protection suitable for dust, humidity, altitude, duty cycle, and site hazards. The technical file should specify IP rating, cooling method, insulation thermal class, service factor or overload margin, and installation instructions in a form usable by the local installer.
target_standards: Applicable Peru workplace and industrial installation requirements
rows.china_equivalent: China common baseline is GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes aligned to IEC 60034-30-1, GB 12665 for cooling and related rotating electrical machine requirements, and CCC for low-voltage motors when the product is inside CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC compulsory certification scope for low-voltage motors
rows.gap: A China catalogue rating may omit Peru site conditions. For mining, coastal, high-altitude, or heavy industrial use, confirm derating, enclosure, cooling, and bearing limits for the actual site.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when required by site safety, buyer specification, or applicable industrial regulation
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline must be rechecked against Peru site conditions

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Add Peru site-condition review to the safety file, especially for 60 Hz industrial duty and harsh environments.
